Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in Step 4 by completely misinterpreting the genealogical data provided by WebSurfer. In Step 3, WebSurfer successfully confirmed that George II's mother was Augusta von Schwarzburg-Sondershausen (1768-1849). However, in Step 4, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandmother was "Christiane Henriette of Palatine Zweibrücken-Birkenfeld" (the mother of George I, Augusta's father) instead of Augusta herself. This represents a failure to correctly map the lineage: the paternal grandmother is the mother of the father (George II), not the mother of the paternal grandfather (George I). The Planner confused the maternal line of the paternal grandfather with the maternal line of the father, leading to an incorrect final answer.
